title: You Can Now Program Real Physical Robots Using Simple AI Prompts!
description:
Imagine programming a physical robot to perform real-world tasks—from handing a mechanic their tools to doing yard work or hiking up a trail to fetch water—without writing a single line of traditional code. Thanks to "vibe coding" AI tools like Claude and Codex, hardware from companies like Pantograph can now be controlled using natural language prompts. While this $4,200 robot is still pricey for most, it marks a huge shift in tech where AI coding is moving off computer screens and straight into the physical world.
